fields.Name: C2 -> S6.2
fields.Description: Gate G2.34 (phase 2, dataset C2, criterion S6.2): on C2 the holdout AUC's bootstrap interval half-width over 1.96 Hanley-McNeil standard errors lies in [0.67, 1.28], 1 of 1. It fails when the AUC bootstrap reports a 68% interval (ratio below 0.67).
